optimizedDescription.value: Incremental two-pass indexer discovers, classifies, resolves, covers, and atomically persists one graph generation.

optimizedContext.value:
# Indexer

## Rules
- `IndexCodeGraph`: Discover → Diff → Extract → Spec Index → Store → Clean → persist `lastIndexedRef`. Indexes source, documents, hierarchy, specs, dependencies, coverage.
- Consume `SpecRepository.list/artifact/readPersistedState` plus `GetSpecMetadata`; no raw sidecar/metadata snapshot when self-healing materialization exists.
- Fingerprint = effective package version + canonical workspace hash + effective discovery filters/spec-root exclusions + newline-normalized hashes of adapter `resolutionManifests()`. Manifest discovery bounded by repo/project root through application port; no application-layer Node FS. Mismatch/incompatible schema→visible provider-owned recreation, generation rotation, full rebuild; reads never silently repair/empty-serve.
- Incremental fingerprint-match run handles new/changed/deleted; content hash authoritative, mtime/size read-avoidance only. Hash match skips only when required persisted resource exists. Deletion scoped to indexed workspaces. Force permits no persisted-artifact skip.
- Discovery: per workspace `codeRoot` with global+spec-root+workspace exclusions/allowed paths; project-global includes outside every code root use `root:`. Adapter match→`FileNode`; textual fallback→`DocumentNode`; specs only through spec index. Paths use `/` without collapsing `.`/`..`; drive-letter keys are paths, never workspace IDs.
- `discoverFiles`: `respectGitignore` default true with absolute priority; `vcsRoot` supplied or null, never probed. Default excludes include `.git/`, `.hg/`, `.svn/`. Binary extension filtering precedes decode. Decode BOM UTF-8/16, then UTF-8, NUL-layout UTF-16, NUL-free windows-1252; otherwise skip.
- Two-pass run-scoped `IndexSession`: Pass 1 analyzes per workspace, registers compact facts, emits `DEFINES`/`EXPORTS`; Pass 2 after all files/workspaces resolves `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy without reparse/store reads. One `bulkLoad()`, then one needed FTS rebuild.
- Session owns compact file/analysis/symbol/document/spec lookups, facts, adapter cache, relation dedupe. No retained AST, raw-map bypass, persisted-ID/schema leakage.
- Shared scoped environment owns scopes, shadowing, bindings, receivers, candidates. `IndexCodeGraph` contains no language rules. Persist deterministic relations only; drop self/unresolved/ambiguous edges.
- Coverage projection uses canonical persisted state against committing generation. File link emits `COVERS_FILE` only if target exists; symbol link emits `COVERS_SYMBOL` only after unique logical resolution anchored to file, including public bindings. Run after re-export facts; never exact-name guess or file fallback. Reproject on implementation/code changes; return stable per-link diagnostic.
- Specs: `count/list`; `GetSpecMetadata.metadataFingerprint` controls skip; title/description from materialization; coverage/dependencies from one persisted-state read. Prefer non-empty `optimizedDescription` for BM25/display.
- Package map uses first adapter `getPackageIdentity(codeRoot)`; adapters own manifests, public entries, cross-workspace binding routes.
- Chunk budget default 20MB; optional staging under graph temp, run-scoped, clean on success/preferably failure.
- Success atomically replaces input observations for every file/document/spec physical input, hashes and VCS evidence, clears stale latches only on complete commit, prunes removed/obsolete. Failure/partial never clears stale.
- Persist logical symbols, declaration occurrences, member semantics, bindings, hierarchy/provenance, coverage outcomes, indexed source text, parser-derived construct/name ranges. Store owned `qualified_name` exact dotted spelling; top-level none. `SymbolKind.Property` persists with container `parentId`. Cross-file overrides include every matching target declaration.
- Relation construction builds declaration/logical/import/public-binding indexes once; individual facts never scan full collections. Bounded batch writes; adapter reference facts precede spec projection.
- Incremental semantic refresh re-extracts new/changed plus transitive importer/relation/hierarchy/public-route closure; addition-only may reconsider unresolved-import candidates without counting unchanged content as indexed. Hydrate compact persisted facts for unchanged declarations. Full corpus replace only force/incompatibility/empty graph.
- Re-export propagation uses affected-route queues. Append bounded chunks to one bulk session, commit once, rebuild search at most once when searchable content changed. Fully unchanged run preserves semantic facts/relations and skips search rebuild while updating freshness metadata.
- Full/incremental equivalent source yields equivalent nodes, ranges, facts, relations, search. Progress/timings separately expose resolution, dependency, adapter, re-export, hierarchy, persistence, search phases.
- Progress: 0–5 discovery/hash; 5–7 diff/cleanup; 7–50 Pass1; 50–80 Pass2; 80–83 specs; 83–95 bulk; 100 done; close each phase callback before heavy next work.
- Per-file errors collect and continue; infrastructure errors abort. `IndexResult` includes counts, errors, duration, workspace breakdown, `vcsRef`, fingerprint, `fullRebuild`, reason.

## Constraints
- Caller opens store; indexer owns no lifecycle/backend.
- Provided `excludePaths` replaces defaults; gitignore exclusions cannot be re-included.
- Pass 2 starts only after Pass 1 for all workspaces.
- Specs exclusively via workspace `SpecRepository`; no filesystem fallback.
- Analysis environment uses in-memory facts only; no store queries.
- Unresolved facts and self-relations never persist.
